The high-quality meat used in this prized dish satisfies meat and curry lovers alike.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Gourmet Meat Curries are [[Meal]]s made by [[Cooking]] [[Raw Gourmet Meat]], [[Goron Spice]], and [[Hylian Rice]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. They heal several of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s when eaten. The [[Meat]] used in these Curries is of high quality, which satisfies lovers of both Meat and Curry. Additional Ingredients can be added to the recipe of Gourmet Meat Curry, which will result in the follow variations: * '''Chilly Gourmet Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Gourmet Meat Curry}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
The high-quality meat used in this prized dish satisfies meat and curry lovers alike.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding cold Ingredients. These Meals grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]] when consumed. * '''Electro Gourmet Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Gourmet Meat Curry}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
The high-quality meat used in this prized dish satisfies meat and curry lovers alike.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding electric Ingredients. When eaten, they will give Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Gourmet Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Gourmet Meat Curry}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
The high-quality meat used in this prized dish satisfies meat and curry lovers alike.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding enduring Ingredients. These Curries completely refill and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Energizing Gourmet Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Gourmet Meat Curry}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
The high-quality meat used in this prized dish satisfies meat and curry lovers alike.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding energizing Ingredients. If eaten, they restore a portion of Link's expended Stamina Wheel. * '''Hasty Gourmet Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Gourmet Meat Curry}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
The high-quality meat used in this prized dish satisfies meat and curry lovers alike.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hasty Ingredients. When they are eaten, Link's movement speed will be temporarily boosted. * '''Hearty Gourmet Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Gourmet Meat Curry}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
The high-quality meat used in this prized dish satisfies meat and curry lovers alike.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hearty Ingredients. Eating them will completely heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him [[Extra Hearts]]. * '''Mighty Gourmet Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Gourmet Meat Curry}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
The high-quality meat used in this prized dish satisfies meat and curry lovers alike.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding mighty Ingredients. Link's attack power will by increased by eating this Curry. * '''Sneaky Gourmet Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Gourmet Meat Curry}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
The high-quality meat used in this prized dish satisfies meat and curry lovers alike.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding sneaky Ingredients. Eating these will increase Link's [[Stealth]] for a short period of time. * '''Spicy Gourmet Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Gourmet Meat Curry}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
The high-quality meat used in this prized dish satisfies meat and curry lovers alike.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding spicy Ingredients. Eating these will grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Tough Gourmet Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Gourmet Meat Curry}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
The high-quality meat used in this prized dish satisfies meat and curry lovers alike.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding tough Ingredients. If eaten, Link's [[Defense]] will increase. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meat Curry * Prime Meat Curry }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Curries, Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK }}
